problem:
$$
T=[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & -2 \\ -3 & -1 & 4\end{aligned}],\,T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}ay+2x-2z \\ bz-3x+cy\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the standard matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{2}$ shown above. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
worked_solution:
Given the vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]\,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & -2 \\ -3 & -1 & 4\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2x-3y-2z \\ -3x-y+4z\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3y+2x-2z \\ 4z-3x-y\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $T$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}-3y+2x-2z \\ 4z-3x+(-1)y\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $a+b+c=4+(-3)+(-1)=0.$
